name: mpu6050-imu
description: MPU-6050 IMU datalogger: 6-axis + temperature sampling over I2C, roll/pitch/yaw estimate, JSONL recording, live HTTP API.

commands: test -e /dev/i2c-1 || echo 'WARNING: /dev/i2c-1 not found - enable I2C (raspi-config nonint do_i2c 0) and reboot'

arguments.name: i2c_bus
arguments.description: I2C bus number (/dev/i2c-N). Pi header pins 3/5 are bus 1.

arguments.name: i2c_addr
arguments.description: I2C address in decimal. 104 = 0x68 (AD0 low), 105 = 0x69 (AD0 high).

arguments.name: sample_rate
arguments.description: Sample rate in Hz (1-1000). Python timing gets jittery above ~400 Hz.

arguments.name: accel_range
arguments.description: Accelerometer full-scale range in g: 2, 4, 8 or 16.

arguments.name: gyro_range
arguments.description: Gyroscope full-scale range in deg/s: 250, 500, 1000 or 2000.

arguments.name: dlpf
arguments.description: Hardware low-pass filter setting 0-6 (0 = 260 Hz off ... 6 = 5 Hz). 3 = ~44 Hz.

arguments.name: filter_alpha
arguments.description: Complementary filter gyro weight (0-1). Higher trusts the gyro more.

arguments.name: calibrate_on_start
arguments.description: 1 = estimate gyro bias for ~2 s at startup (sensor must be still), 0 = skip.

arguments.name: autorecord
arguments.description: 1 = start JSONL recording as soon as the program starts, 0 = wait for a record command.

arguments.name: segment_seconds
arguments.description: Start a new recording file every N seconds while recording (0 = one file per recording).

arguments.name: host
arguments.description: HTTP API bind address. The dashboard proxy only needs 127.0.0.1.

sockets.name: http_api
sockets.description: IMU JSON API (data, settings, recording, calibration)
